Dear ImGui sources are not bundled in this delivery. Use `python3 tools/fetch_imgui.py`
or CMake's pinned fetch, or set INV_IMGUI_DIR to an audited offline source tree.

See THIRD_PARTY.md and the upstream LICENSE.txt once fetched.
